While they specialize in new construction and major renovations, handling punch list repairs for external projects falls outside their standard service model. Customers seeking repairs for existing structures might benefit from a general handyman service or a contractor specializing in smaller-scale maintenance, depending on the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maine Results, Inc. generally handles punch list repairs only for projects they construct, not external ones.
